proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spell_parameter_override
proposed_widenings.justification: Magic items can grant a named spell but constrain or override part of that spell's authored payload. The current surface can override DC and targeting only; it cannot narrow a granted spell's allowed command mode or replace the spell's printed area shape/range header.

notes: The top-level magic-item activation family already fits: rare attunement item, 7-charge pool, fixed-DC spell grants, dawn recharge, and last-charge destruction roll. The blocker is narrower: the granted-spell surface cannot honestly express spell-specific payload overrides for Command and Fear, so no content file was authored.
